problem: The direct Artifact download URL had no focused regression proving that cross-project callers are denied before storage content is read.
root_cause: Authorization existed in the secured wrapper, but the security boundary was not protected by a test that observes the downstream download call.

change.behavior: Added an owner/stranger regression around get_phase2_artifact_download_secured; the foreign-project branch must raise 403 and must not invoke get_phase2_artifact_download.

assertions: storage/download function call count remains zero for denied access
authorized owner can read the same Artifact
authorized download is invoked exactly once

new_findings: CO-029 remains open for broader cross-project/cross-user fuzzing across exact routes.
